# Regulator F&B

Regulator F&B is a food and beverage regulatory intelligence service that summarizes FDA, USDA, Federal Register, recall, import, labeling, packaging, food-safety, and compliance-deadline updates for operators.

## High-value public pages

- Home: https://regulatorfb.com/
- Operator guides: https://regulatorfb.com/guides/
- Regulatory topic archives: https://regulatorfb.com/topics/
- Compliance calendar: https://regulatorfb.com/calendar/
- Regulatory deadlines: https://regulatorfb.com/deadlines/
- Sample Weekly Action Brief: https://regulatorfb.com/samples/beverage-copacker-action-brief/
- Persona pages: https://regulatorfb.com/for/operations-leads/, https://regulatorfb.com/for/fsqa-managers/
- Newsletter: https://regulatorfb.com/newsletter/

## Regulatory deadline pages

- BHT food comment deadline, July 13, 2026: https://regulatorfb.com/deadlines/bht-food-comment-deadline-july-2026/
- Azodicarbonamide food comment deadline, July 13, 2026: https://regulatorfb.com/deadlines/azodicarbonamide-food-comment-deadline-july-2026/
- Food traceability comments deadline, July 15, 2026: https://regulatorfb.com/deadlines/food-traceability-lot-level-comments-july-2026/
- FSIS swine inspection effective date, July 20, 2026: https://regulatorfb.com/deadlines/fsis-swine-inspection-effective-july-2026/
- National Organic Program sunset renewals, July 26, 2026: https://regulatorfb.com/deadlines/national-organic-program-sunset-renewals-july-2026/
